author: TeIq
content:
Smoke test surface landed end-to-end as part of `.design/polaris-operationally-complete.md` (REQ-E1 / AC-E1).

`polaris-backend/tests/smoke_e2e.rs` walks the entire producer slice hermetically under a MockFetcher: OAuth login → wizard step 1 (generate-key) → step 2 (publish-labeler-record) → step 3 (request-plc-signature) → step 4 (submit-plc-operation) → action submission → WebSocket subscribeLabels → verify_label → /metrics scrape. Wall-clock 2.23s. Runs every PR via the existing test job (.github/workflows/ci.yml).

Operator-facing entry point: `cargo xtask smoke-local` runs the same test locally.

Lexicon-drift watchdog (REQ-E2/E3): `cargo xtask lexicon-contract` against pinned upstream commit cb1387899f0b296759ebdf5b8985b6b573091a9a; 6 lexicons PASS. Weekly cron in .github/workflows/lexicon-contract.yml opens a new GitHub issue per drift event.

The manual smoke session against polarislabeler.bsky.social that originally motivated this issue surfaced seven discrete production bugs (leptos csr feature missing, signer chicken-and-egg boot, OAuth scope drift, DPoP nonce retry, PLC services/verificationMethods merge, bincode envelope drift, no CSS). All seven are closed in the working tree; the smoke_e2e test pins the wire-shape contracts so regression is mechanical-failure.
